errors.text_span: 嵌套在“心理活动”切片内的次级饼图
errors.evidence: There is no secondary pie chart nested within the '心理活动' slice; the description misrepresents the figure structure.
Both '文教' and '战争' are misattributed a deep red color; '文教' is shown in dark gray and '战争' in purple.
The description fails to mention that the slices have their percentage values displayed inside them, which is an important visual feature.
The description does not clearly state the overall purpose of the chart in depicting the distribution of male verb semantic domains in Chinese.
